analytics.name: Analytic 1929
analytics.guidance: Real-time monitoring identifies a loss of communication with serially-connected field devices correlated with a configuration change event on the serial-to-Ethernet gateway. Documented in the 2015 Ukraine attack, where Sandworm used malicious firmware to render serial-to-Ethernet converters inoperable. OT operational-fidelity gate: Alert only when the action is not attributable to an authorized operator/engineering source for the specific target and function, and it is either outside an approved change/maintenance window or lacks matching change-control context; where telemetry permits, require corroborating device, configuration, or process-state effect. Suppress activity that fully matches approved maintenance, commissioning, failover, recovery, or tested control procedures.

tuning.description: Time window within which a serial gateway configuration change and subsequent device communication loss are considered causally connected.

log_sources.name: operationaldb:AlarmEvent
log_sources.channel: device_ip communication-loss alarm within serial block correlation window of a flagged serial gateway configuration change

log_sources.name: serialgw:syslog
log_sources.channel: serial port parameter change (baud rate, parity, port disable) without corresponding change ticket reference
